precepts.why:
Achior runs Israel's whole history down to Holofernes, and in it is part of the key to getting out of this mess: “whilst they sinned not before their God, they prospered, because the God that hateth iniquity was with them.” So the objective of our enemies is to keep us from obeying God, to keep us in dysfunction so they can dominate us. They love that we're brilliant; they want the body and the mind, but they don't want us using that mind for ourselves. And the counsel he gives: “if there be any error against this people, and they sin against their God, let us consider that this shall be their ruin, and let us go up, and we shall overcome them.” That is exactly what is happening to us now. “But if there be no iniquity in their nation, let my lord now pass by, lest their Lord defend them.” That's where our power is: checking each other so there is no sin in the nation.

Add this to your prayers: “Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God. For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.” They are God's enemies, lifting up their heads against everything that is about the Most High.

“They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.” AIPAC counsel, The Israel Project counsel, ADL counsel, Canary Mission counsel: consultation, secret meetings against us. Not Hamas, not Hezbollah: the blacks in this country, because they read the prophecy.

“They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.” In their meetings, the discussion is to cut us off from the Most High, from who we truly are, from the image of God, and morph us into the image of dysfunction. They do it to us because we are the Israelites.

note.label: Joseph in Egypt: Then & Now

precepts.why:
Jacob called his sons together in Egypt to tell them “that which shall befall you in the last days,” and highlight those last words: the last days. Of Joseph he said, “Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall.” By a well: they would live by the waters, on islands, in the last days. The walls are forts like El Morro, built by the Spanish to keep the other European powers out of places like Puerto Rico. “The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him”: the conquistadors sorely grieved him. “But his bow abode in strength.”

The Spaniards' own records, gathered in the book Lost Tribes and Promised Land, bear this out. Duran found Judaic customs in the old Aztec religion, unleavened bread on certain days and bathing for purification, and came to believe the Indians descended from the lost tribes of Israel. In 1644 an Indian guide named Francisco declared that his countrymen would be avenged upon the Spaniards in time by means of a people now hidden. Montesinos, a Judaizer imprisoned by the Inquisition, was reciting the formula of the New World Marranos, Blessed be the name of the Lord, who has not made me an idolater, a barbarian, a negro, an Indian, when he stopped and told himself, Those Indians, they are Hebrews. Indians later came to Antonio de Montesinos and recited the Shema in Hebrew, Hear, O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one, and told him they were of the tribe of Reuben, and that the tribe of Joseph lived on an island nearby. That is Puerto Rico, with Manasseh in Cuba.

That people now hidden is Judah, and the Psalm uses the same words the record used: “They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.” Israel is God's hidden people, and the nations have taken crafty counsel against them. The Spaniards' records, which they collected and kept, testify of the hidden ones the Bible speaks of.

Christ says, “And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul”. They can't kill the real you, brothers and sisters. You think that body is the real you, but it is just a shell that corrodes in time. So why is our people so afraid to die? David shows it: “They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.”

Slavery, miseducation and religion are all part of that crafty counsel. Their religions make you think this is all there is, like the Sam Cooke song: I don't know what's up there beyond the sky. It puts a spirit of fear on you: if you die, you're going to hell and you're going to burn down there. So everybody is afraid to die.

But when you read the Bible, how come our foremothers and forefathers did not have the spirit we have today? They knew something we don't. The woman with the seven sons said, kill me now, cut my arms off, cut my tongue. We say, what the hell is this? Because the crafty counsel taught us lie after lie about reality: that after this you're done.

The Bible calls death sleep, many times. That's all it is, and you wake up before the Lord. Paul said to be absent from the body is to be present with the Lord. But do we believe that, or what the white man says on his television screens?

Christ goes on, “but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell”: that is the lake of fire, which is not now. When you die now, everybody is at rest, even the wicked. When the Lord returns he takes the keys of hell and death and opens it all up, and that is when the lake of fire comes. So don't fear them that kill the body, because the things we teach will get us killed, and you will not deny Christ if you have not swallowed their crafty counsel.
